_help: Partner offers shown in the 'partners' bar on every page and on /partners.html. To add an offer copy one item, fill it in and set active to true. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (the offer shows from start until the end of the end day). topics (optional) = words from the page address, e.g. ["diploma", "syrian-documents"]; leave it out to show the offer on all pages. code is optional. Never publish an offer without the partner's written OK.
